item.g:title: Mega Charizard Tin (Mega Charizard X)
item.g:description:
roduct Details Card Text:Choose Your Charizard! Under the right conditions—including a strong bond with its Trainer—Charizard can surpass its own limits and Mega Evolve! With this tin, you can choose the raging blue flames of Mega Charizard X ex or the aerial agility of Mega Charizard Y ex, then find more Pokémon inside a handful of booster packs.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Charizard Tin includes: • 1 foil promo card featuring Mega Charizard X ex or Mega Charizard Y ex • 4 Pokémon TCG booster packs • A code card for Pokémon TCG Live
